nodes.query_template: MATCH (v:tech_point) RETURN id(v) AS vid, v.tech_point.name_zh AS name, v.tech_point.weighted_degree AS weighted_degree ORDER BY vid SKIP {offset} LIMIT {limit};

edges.query_template: MATCH ()-[e:tech_rel]->() RETURN src(e) AS src, dst(e) AS dst, rank(e) AS edge_rank, e.relation_confidence_score AS confidence ORDER BY src, dst, edge_rank SKIP {offset} LIMIT {limit};

consistency: Ordered sequential reads, count guards; not a transactional snapshot.
